Choose a role from the header, then click sidebar links, cards, action buttons, or the login preview buttons. All routes use sample records based on the modules in your uploaded PHP system.

Interactive: sidebar navigation, adding/editing records (example screens), QR scanner path, attendance import preview/confirm, payments, clearance, officer management, settings, password reset and logout.

Not connected: PHP/MySQL authentication, QR cameras, CSV writes, payment processing and real record changes. Those belong to your locally running system, not a visual prototype.
